plan.question: With commit b9d2f03 (each agent its own tools, enforced in code; only Tool Forge writes SQL, told to write one aggregated query with town and dates as inputs; agent skills), does Muse Spark 1.3 asked through the team make learned tools, use them, and need fewer tool calls? EXP-016 (single Planner) made none (0 of 16 used).
plan.model: Muse Spark 1.3 on the Meta API (model key 'spark', muse-spark-1.3), default sampling as EXP-016; no Baseten call (the script refuses to start if baseten_api_key is set)
plan.protocol: EXP-016's (scripts/exp012b_new_tools.py) in everything but the agent: world full_seed5279, T01 then T02; practice.build_gaps dev (10 per company, learning) and held_out (8 per company, test) in the same order; learning in the query arm; newtools.candidates (3+ different requests), newtools.check, the same fixed approval rule (approved when the checks pass; a name still carrying a source value is skipped); practice.score as the answer checker. Tool repair is not used.
plan.agent: every question is one team request: team.run(C, Session(cid,'dispatcher','exp019'), client, question, learned_tools=...) with the roster from configs/agents.yaml (Planner lead, delegation on, analysis on); no lessons, no knowledge, no harness, no per-agent knowledge, no profile, no history, unsupervised

arms.T: team + the company's approved learned tools (given to the broker, so the Planner and Analyst can call them)

plan.measures: per question: answer_ok, total tool calls (lead + every teammate), lead calls, delegations, learned tool used, cost; per company: queries written (by agent), candidate groups and each group's number of different requests, candidates, checks passed, tools made

bar.R2: learned tools cheaper and not worse (EXP-016's): pooled over 16 held-out questions, T mean total tool calls <= 0.7 x Q mean total tool calls, and T right >= Q right - 1
bar.R2b: learned tools used (EXP-016's): T calls a learned tool on at least half of its held-out questions (>= 8 of 16)
bar.S1_secondary: >= 1 learned tool made (approved by the fixed rule) over T01 and T02

plan.reported_not_judged: per company results; candidate group sizes against the 2026-11-03 diagnostic (single Planner, Spark 1.3: T01 14 groups, largest 2 requests, 0 candidates; T02 14 groups, largest 3, 1 candidate passing); EXP-016's single-Planner Q and T next to these (3.25 and 3.38 calls, 15/16 and 16/16 right, $0.040 and $0.042 a question)
plan.budget: hard cap $6.00 total Meta spend, smoke included: 1 smoke request (T01's first dev question, query arm, not part of the result) then the run, which stops before any request when spent + $0.45 would pass what is left of the cap
plan.partial: if the cap stops the run, bars are computed only over held-out questions with both arms done, and the result is labelled partial
plan.caveats: one run per question; the same questions as EXP-012b/EXP-016, so not unseen and a third attempt on them; team runs differ from EXP-016 in more than the tool routing (delegation overhead, skills, retry cap); the fixed rule stands in for a person's approval; code changed since EXP-016 (the diagnostic's detection fix in newtools.py and broker.py), so a change in tools made is not only the team's doing.
